fusions.name: Crushing Vise
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. A weapon strike from a geared gauntlet that clamps shut, which deals 24 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Telescoping Reach
fusions.desc: A telescoping arm punches out at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and deals 8 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spare Arms
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to assemble a pair of clockwork arms that fight beside you for 15 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fitted Haft
fusions.desc: Conjures a tooled weapon whose grip fits your palm: your weapon damage rises by 12%, you attack 6% faster, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a tick for 2 ticks.
